The story follows Lily, the last surviving priestess in a land devastated by an endless and oppressive rain (named rain of death) that drives living things demented and transforms them into undead while granting immortality, also known as blighted. Awakening in a church with no recollection of recent events, Lily turns to exploring beyond the safety of the sanctuary to find the source of the rain. Along the way, Lily can summon the spirits of purified undead to protect her.
